messages.text: Hello, you refunded my kettle last week, thank you, but I also paid 18 reais shipping for a kettle that arrived broken. I want the shipping refunded.

Thanks for getting in touch. Under the policy, shipping charges are never refunded automatically, but a staff member can review them (refund-policy/v2/shipping).

Would you like a staff member to review the shipping charge?
